name: Mastra Platform Starter
free_limit: 100,000 observability events/month; 24 CPU hours/month; 10 GB data egress/month; 15-day data retention; unlimited users, projects and deployments
watch_out: Starter is $0/month but usage above monthly allowances is pay-as-you-go: $10/100K observability events, $0.35/CPU hour and $0.10/GB egress. Set credit top-up/auto-top-up cautiously; a persistent always-on server is $100/project. Model/Gateway tokens, storage and other metered services have separate charges. Card requirement and commercial-use terms remain unconfirmed.
